Explicit consultations and material continuation changes receive a full source, issue, C27, operation, validator, and module-use dashboard. A portable route receipt schema, structural gate, and exact-answer local binding controller are included; they cannot discover omitted conditional work or authenticate model-reported activity. This skills-only plugin has no ChatGPT host hook, so host-level release enforcement is not established. The bundled corpus is a versioned snapshot; consult official publishers to confirm live currentness. Personal use is intended.
